cues.en: This section of the course is all about functions in Python.
cues.zh: 這一節，全部介紹 Python 函式。

cues.en: Now, I've already introduced you to several functions like the length function.
cues.zh: 已經介紹過幾個函式，例如 len，取得長度。

cues.en: And let's see, there was converting integers and strings into floats and so on.
cues.zh: 還有把整數、字串轉成浮點數等等。

cues.en: Quite a few functions that you already learned in this video.
cues.zh: 已經學過不少函式。這支影片，

cues.en: I'm going to tell you a little bit more about syntax as well as introduce you to some additional functions.
cues.zh: 會進一步說明語法，也介紹一些新函式。

cues.en: And then over the next several videos, you'll learn more and more about how to use functions, how to get help on functions and so on.
cues.zh: 接下來幾支影片，會繼續學如何使用函式、取得函式說明等等。

cues.en: So right now I want to introduce you to another function called Sum.
cues.zh: 現在介紹另一個函式，叫作 sum。

cues.en: The sum function basically just adds up a bunch of numbers.
cues.zh: sum 基本上就是把一組數字加起來。

cues.en: So let's write some and then I'm going to input a list.
cues.zh: 寫 sum，再輸入串列。

cues.en: So this is a list that I'm creating inside the sum function.
cues.zh: 這是直接在 sum 函式裡建立的串列。

cues.en: And then I press control, enter on the keyboard, and we get the number 60.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+Enter，得到 60。

cues.en: No surprise.
cues.zh: 不意外。

cues.en: That's the sum of all of those numbers.
cues.zh: 就是那些數字的總和。

cues.en: Now, we can also make this a separate variable, so I'll call this, I don't know, just call this var for variable.
cues.zh: 也能把它做成獨立變數，叫作，我也不知道，就叫 var，代表變數。

cues.en: Set that to be a list, and then I sum over the elements in var.
cues.zh: 把它設成串列，再加總 var 的元素。

cues.en: Now these are all numbers in this list.
cues.zh: 串列裡全部都是數字。

cues.en: Of course, lists are not limited to numbers.
cues.zh: 當然，串列不限數字。

cues.en: What's going to happen if I try to sum a list that contains a string?
cues.zh: 如果試著加總包含字串的串列，會怎樣？

cues.en: Let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Now we get an error.
cues.zh: 出現錯誤。

cues.en: So this says unsupported operand type plus four, int and string.
cues.zh: 它說，加號不支援 int 與 str 這組運算元型別。

cues.en: So basically inside the sum function, Python is trying to add up all of these elements and it doesn't know what to do when it gets here.
cues.zh: 基本上，sum 裡面，Python 試著把元素全部加起來，但到這裡，就不知道該怎麼處理。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And let's try this again with a list of numbers.
cues.zh: 再試著把數字串列當成其中一個元素。

cues.en: Just out of curiosity, you know, whenever you're curious about something, you have a question about how something might work in Python.
cues.zh: 純粹好奇。對 Python 有疑問，想知道某件事如何運作時，

cues.en: Just try it.
cues.zh: 直接試試。

cues.en: It's a great thing about programming languages.
cues.zh: 這是程式語言很棒的地方。

cues.en: You can just try it and see what happens.
cues.zh: 可以直接試，看看結果。

cues.en: So let's see what happens here.
cues.zh: 看看這裡會怎樣。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And again, we get an error message that says we don't know how to add ints and lists.
cues.zh: 同樣出錯，說不知道如何把 int 與 list 相加。

cues.en: So these are all integers.
cues.zh: 這些都是整數。

cues.en: Now we can run another little experiment and say, well, you know, okay, fair enough.
cues.zh: 再做個小實驗，好吧，合理。

cues.en: These have to be numeric.
cues.zh: 這些必須是數值。

cues.en: But you know, now that there are two types of numbers, there are ints and there are floats.
cues.zh: 但現在知道，數字有 int 與 float 兩種。

cues.en: So let's see what happens if we try to mix ints and floats.
cues.zh: 試著混合 int 與 float，會怎樣？

cues.en: So these are integers, and here we have a floating point number and the result is, well, it is the sum of those numbers.
cues.zh: 這些是整數，這裡是浮點數，結果就是那些數字的總和。

cues.en: So no problem.
cues.zh: 所以沒有問題。

cues.en: We can mix integers and floating point numbers.
cues.zh: 可以混合整數與浮點數。

cues.en: Okay, very nice.
cues.zh: 好，非常好。

cues.en: So I mentioned before, and I want to reiterate that functions always have parentheses for their when specifying their inputs.
cues.zh: 之前提過，這裡再強調，指定函式輸入時，使用小括號。

cues.en: So if you try to use a square bracket like this for some, first of all, you see that the the color changed and then Python gives us an error.
cues.zh: 如果像這樣，對 sum 使用方括號，首先，顏色變了，接著 Python 報錯。

cues.en: It says object is not subscript double.
cues.zh: 說 object is not subscriptable，物件不能下標索引。

cues.en: This means that Python thinks that we want to get the 10th element.
cues.zh: 表示 Python 以為要取得第 10 個元素，

cues.en: The 20th element.
cues.zh: 第 20 個元素。

cues.en: Python thinks that we are trying to index something a function some, but that is it just doesn't make any sense.
cues.zh: 以為我們想索引 sum 這個函式，但完全沒有意義。

cues.en: That's not defined for this thing.
cues.zh: 這種操作沒有定義。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So when you're working with functions and giving inputs into functions, you always use parentheses.
cues.zh: 所以，使用函式、提供輸入時，一律使用小括號。

cues.en: Now, another concept that I've already introduced you to, but I want to make sure it's explicit here is that functions give outputs.
cues.zh: 另外，之前已介紹過的概念，現在明確說明：函式會給出輸出。

cues.en: So I'm going to call this output and the way that the inputs and outputs work is that the inputs go
cues.zh: 我把它叫作 output。輸入與輸出的方式是，輸入放在

cues.en: after the function call inside parentheses and the outputs of the function or the result of the algorithm
cues.zh: 函式名稱之後的小括號裡，而輸出，也就是函式演算法、

cues.en: or computation that the function is implementing is goes to the left with an equal sign.
cues.zh: 計算的結果，放在左邊，以等號指定。

cues.en: So output equals function name input.
cues.zh: output=函式名稱(輸入)。

cues.en: And then we can see, in fact, I think I'll print this out.
cues.zh: 接著查看，其實我把它印出來。

cues.en: So print the sum is and now we need a plus sign.
cues.zh: 使用 print，寫「總和是」，再接加號。

cues.en: And of course you you know, now that this is going to give an error, right?
cues.zh: 當然，你現在知道會出錯，對吧？

cues.en: This is going to give an error because Python doesn't know what to do with the plus sign for strings and numbers.
cues.zh: 因為 Python 不知道如何用加號結合字串與數字。

cues.en: So we need to convert this into a string like this and now we get a correct result.
cues.zh: 所以，像這樣轉成字串，就得到正確結果。

cues.en: Now, some functions can take multiple inputs and provide multiple outputs.
cues.zh: 有些函式，能接受多個輸入，也能提供多個輸出。

cues.en: If there are multiple inputs, then you would separate the inputs by a comma.
cues.zh: 多個輸入，以逗號分隔。

cues.en: And I'm not explaining what this input is now, but you will learn what this is in future.
cues.zh: 現在不解釋這個輸入是什麼，之後會學到。

cues.en: But just to show you that we can provide multiple inputs into a function by separating them with commas
cues.zh: 只是展示，能用逗號分開，提供多個輸入。

cues.en: and some functions also provide multiple outputs, in which case those will also be separated by commas.
cues.zh: 有些函式也有多個輸出，同樣以逗號分開。

cues.en: So if the sum function gave two outputs, we would have the first output and the second output.
cues.zh: 所以，如果 sum 有兩個輸出，就會有第一個輸出與第二個輸出。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So I hope that gives you a little bit more familiarity with working with functions.
cues.zh: 希望你更熟悉函式的使用。

cues.en: Of course you're going to get a lot more experience over the next several videos and the rest of this course and the rest of your life as a programmer.
cues.zh: 當然，接下來幾支影片、這門課其餘內容，以及往後程式設計生涯，都會累積更多經驗。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: But let's let's do an exercise.
cues.zh: 來做練習。

cues.en: This is a pretty simple exercise.
cues.zh: 很簡單的練習。

cues.en: You want to compute the mean and the mean.
cues.zh: 計算 mean，也就是平均值。

cues.en: I mean the the arithmetic average of of var of of this list here.
cues.zh: 我指的是 var，這份串列的算術平均。

cues.en: So what is the average value of this list?
cues.zh: 串列的平均值是多少？

cues.en: Now, there is no function in python called mean we have some and but there isn't a function called mean.
cues.zh: Python 內建沒有叫作 mean 的函式，有 sum，但沒有 mean。

cues.en: Now if you're if you've worked with Python a little bit before, you might know that there is a numpy function and mean there's a math function in me, but I haven't yet introduced you to these libraries.
cues.zh: 如果之前用過 Python，也許知道 NumPy 有 mean，其他數學函式庫也有平均值函式，但還沒有介紹那些函式庫。

cues.en: So for now you have to compute the sum, the sorry, the the average of this set of numbers using functions
cues.zh: 所以目前，只能使用前幾支影片已經知道的函式，計算這組數字的總和，

cues.en: that you already know from the past several videos.
cues.zh: 抱歉，是平均值。

cues.en: So pause the video, have a go at this.
cues.zh: 暫停影片，試試看。

cues.en: And now I'm going to show you my solution.
cues.zh: 現在展示我的解法。

cues.en: It's actually pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 其實相當直接。

cues.en: So to compute the mean, we sum over all of the elements and then we divide by the number of elements.
cues.zh: 把所有元素加總，再除以元素數量，就得到平均。

cues.en: So that gives us an average of 20.1 to 5, I assume.
That's correct.
cues.zh: 這是正確的。

cues.en: I think I'll actually change this to ten, 20, 30 because this is really easy to compute in our head and therefore confirm that the correct answer should be 20.
cues.zh: 我把它改成 10、20、30，因為在腦中很容易計算，也能確認正確答案應該是 20。

cues.en: By the way, you can see this is still this still says 80.5, which actually tripped me up for a second.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這裡仍顯示 80.5，我剛才也愣了一下。

cues.en: But the reason is that we are calling variable output, but I rename this to output one.
cues.zh: 原因是，這裡仍使用 output，但我把變數改名成 output1。

cues.en: This is a common source of errors in coding and you can see I just made this error of myself.
cues.zh: 這是常見程式錯誤，而我自己也犯了。

cues.en: If you change a variable name, you have to be really, really careful, really mindful of changing that variable name back later.
cues.zh: 變數改名時，必須非常小心、留意，後面使用的名稱也要改。

cues.en: In fact, later on in the course, I'm going to show you how to make sure that you're not making mistakes like this for now.
cues.zh: 事實上，課程後面會展示，如何確保不犯這類錯誤。目前，

cues.en: Suffice it to say that any time you change a variable name, make sure to be mindful that you change that variable name everywhere it appears.
cues.zh: 只要知道，每次改變數名稱，都要留意它出現的每個地方，一併修改。
